title: Constraint-Level Regulation via Multi-Channel Obstruction Diagnostics
description: This paper defines a repair-selection controller for discrete constraint-system evolution. The system monitors five obstruction channels—geometric quotient residual (Phi_geom), logical inconsistency (Phi_sat), structural closure defect (Phi_curv), representative distortion (Xi), and relational interface drift (Phi_rel)—to evaluate and rank candidate repair operator proposals under explicit guardrails, including the piecewise closure ratio (R_cl) and guarded descent bounds. Candidate selection is separated from state transition verification, ensuring that exploratory operator proposals are screened prior to state commitment. The repository provides a reference Python implementation, test suite, and local-first verification manifests.
notes: Manuscript and documentation: CC-BY-4.0. Python reference implementation and tests: MIT. To verify the deposit locally, run 'py -3.12 -m pytest code/tests/test_constraint_regulation.py' followed by 'py -3.12 verify_deposit.py'.
